title: PRAME Logic-First Transfer
subtitle: A focused decision run centered on decision logic and evidence boundaries
research_goal: Show how a focused transfer decision can present mechanism, assay validity, and an unresolved human decision without implying experimental validation.
summary: The synthetic run preserves a primary target-context gate and a conditional verifier-first contrast as separate reviewed objects. It does not claim that a broad discovery process occurred.
scientific_decision: Review the target-context gate before any experimental recommendation and retain the verifier contrast conditionally. Literature-supported components are not promoted into candidate-level validation.

timeline.label: Transfer framing
timeline.detail: A focused decision and non-goals were separated.

timeline.label: Boundary review
timeline.detail: Direct and analogical support were labeled separately.

timeline.label: Human decision
timeline.detail: One target-context assumption remains open for review.

pairwise_selection_impact: No pairwise comparison was required for this focused transfer decision.
